name: Magic Hour
description_en:
Magic Hour is a product in the AI video category. Its directory profile covers Video Snippets, AI Assistant, Video Stabilization, AI Optimization, Animation, Support Audio / Images / Video, Video, Text in Image.

Additional listed capabilities include Collaboration. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $10.00. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: use model-assisted interactions within the product workflow; create motion or animated visual elements. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
